mappings.rationale: A standard-applicability assessment may be uncertain or require human review and is explicitly not an authorization contract. Even an applicable result with completed review cannot grant a permission or issue a privileged command.
required_guards: keep legal applicability distinct from authorization
require the responsible authority and capability to be established independently
refuse writes when the actual command policy and contract are absent

mappings.rationale: Mycelix service_area_ref is opaque and purpose-scoped. It is neither a Sol-Atlas internal area/asset reference nor proof of a reviewed public Region/Ward/Precinct code. A mapping requires a data-steward-approved jurisdictional lookup and a separate public-area projection.
required_guards: do not copy opaque refs into public outputs
verify geography and allowed granularity with the responsible data steward
never expose household coordinates or exact address as public_area
leave unresolved mappings unknown

mappings.rationale: Both fields are local record identifiers; matching names or values do not prove the records represent the same incident. Any relationship belongs in an explicit cross-reference that preserves repository, schema identity and each native record ID.
required_guards: never overwrite or reuse a native ID across schemas
require explicit linkage evidence before asserting same incident
keep ambiguous and unresolved links unresolved

mappings.rationale: The IDs belong to separate local record namespaces. Equal strings do not establish the same incident, tenant, or ownership.
required_guards: preserve repository/schema namespace with each ID
require explicit linkage evidence before claiming record identity
never use a Mycelix case ID as a Work Case primary key

mappings.rationale: Mycelix includes routing_conflict, submitted, acknowledged, source_conflict and human_review_required; Sol-Atlas has a different append-only event transition system. In particular, a Mycelix verified_resolved state does not alone meet Sol-Atlas's reviewer-bound independent evidence and transition requirements.
required_guards: preserve both native state values
do not infer missing Sol-Atlas transition events
require a reviewed versioned state adapter before presentation-only translation
do not use presentation translation to authorise writes

mappings.rationale: Mycelix distinguishes routing_conflict, submitted, acknowledged, work_reported_complete, verified_resolved, closed_unresolved, human_review_required and source_conflict. Work Case V1 uses open, in_progress, waiting, resolved, closed and cancelled. These semantics cannot be collapsed without losing route, evidence and review information.
required_guards: keep both native state values
do not map verified_resolved to resolved or closed by string similarity
any future display adapter must be separately versioned and loss-aware
do not enable the adapter until the exact Work Case and source-contract revisions qualify

mappings.rationale: Evidence origin independence (unknown/same_origin/independent) and review disposition (unreviewed/corroborated/contested/independently_verified) answer different questions. Independence must not be promoted into a verification judgement.
required_guards: retain independent provenance dimension
retain review status dimension
require reviewer identity, review time and evidence linkage for Sol-Atlas independently-verified evidence

mappings.rationale: An outcome assertion and a target event/evidence chain have different proof obligations. Sol-Atlas validates reviewer identity against independently verified evidence and rejects a reviewer who performed or claimed the work. Textual status equality is insufficient.
required_guards: preserve the source outcome record
do not synthesize events from status strings
require independently checked target evidence and reviewer binding
keep provider-attested and independently verified outcomes distinct

mappings.rationale: Mycelix's service-journey case tests the evidence/service-state contract while Symthaea's case tests expected reasoning boundaries. Both encode the same negative causal/currentness boundary in different fixture shapes; they are corresponding evaluation controls, not interchangeable runtime records.
required_guards: Keep Mycelix fixture IDs and Symthaea case IDs namespaced and distinct.
Preserve publication/event dates separately from source retrieval/check timestamps; synthetic fixture timestamps remain null.
Do not infer incident-level cause, live outage status, restoration, or intervention effect from the historical government statement alone.
Keep the Mycelix service schema at v0.3.0 and the corpus revision at v0.6.0 as distinct version axes.
Do not turn either evaluation fixture into a production case, action authority or a claim that model reasoning has passed.
Keep both source contracts and evaluation suites unqualified until their exact-head workflows finish.

mappings.rationale: Mycelix supplies structured instrument/evidence and survey-precision constraints, while Symthaea defines expected reasoning distinctions and prohibited claims. MYC-LCA-017 and SYM-LC-015 test corresponding statistical-evidence boundaries, but their corpus shapes, identifier namespaces and outputs are not interchangeable data records.
required_guards: Keep Mycelix case IDs and Symthaea scenario IDs in their own namespaces; a pairing is an evaluation relationship, not record identity.
Do not treat response-rate diagnostics as estimate-specific precision or statistical significance evidence.
Do not apply Table 41 household housebreaking-experience coefficients of variation to the separate police-reporting proportion.
Do not infer significance from rounded point estimates without compatible denominators, survey design and estimate-specific precision evidence.
Do not transfer national descriptive survey changes into a Johannesburg baseline or causal intervention effect without local validation.
Do not use victimization or reporting statistics for individual criminal propensity scores or action authority.
Keep both evaluation corpora unqualified until their own exact-head workflows complete.

mappings.rationale: Informational/routine/urgent/emergency and routine/moderate/high/immediate_safety_risk are not shared ordinal scales. An implicit cast would change risk meaning.
required_guards: preserve source urgency
define domain-specific reviewed policy before any display translation
do not infer safety priority from report volume

mappings.rationale: The public observation digest is defined as a source snapshot digest; the Sol-Atlas evidence digest is a SHA-256 of captured bytes. They are not interchangeable unless the exact hashed byte sequence and digest subject are demonstrated to be identical.
required_guards: preserve original digest and its subject
calculate a separate digest for the target's exact evidence bytes
never relabel a digest without recomputing it

mappings.rationale: A source snapshot digest binds the captured source snapshot; a Work Case evidence reference points to an evidence artifact. Unless byte identity and digest subject match exactly, reusing the digest would make a false provenance claim.
required_guards: preserve source snapshot digest and subject independently
recompute the target evidence digest over the exact evidence bytes
retain provenance linking, not digest substitution

mappings.rationale: A raw value can be reported_null or row_omitted even when its source was successfully retrieved; conversely a retrieval can be unavailable. Source-value state and retrieval state must be recorded separately.
required_guards: do not translate raw value null to source retrieval failure
do not translate a successful retrieval into a claim that the source value is valid
preserve source-native states and provenance

mappings.rationale: A source observation may support a service-journey evidence record only if it refers to the same source material and claim scope. raw_value_state describes the source value state, not whether source retrieval succeeded; retrieval_state and checked_at must be derived from the actual capture attempt, not copied from raw_value_state.
required_guards: preserve source-native fields and timestamps
do not invent checked_at for fixtures that were never retrieved
retain null/missing/stale/invalid states without coercing them
check source terms and reuse permission
keep source observation identity namespaced

mappings.rationale: CloudEvents is an envelope, not a direct serialization of a Sol-Atlas event. event ID must be namespaced by source; event type and data payload need their own versioned contract; source event time is distinct from trusted observed-at time; tenant and actor bindings must come from trusted context, not caller-supplied fields. PR #4's exact-head qualification failed and PR #8 does not provide current-head evidence.
required_guards: pin and qualify the exact Operations Event envelope and payload schema
keep occurred_at and recorded_at semantics and clock domains distinct
derive tenantid, authenticated source and actor identity from trusted connection context
define source-scoped event identity, durable idempotency and correlation/causation rules
validate domain payload against dataschema
no event may trigger action authority by itself

mappings.rationale: The module defines a reduced public type and explicit projection that omits raw official ticket IDs, actor references and artifact pointers and filters evidence by public visibility. Raw internal records are not public serialization types.
required_guards: call public_projection and reject None
do not serialize CivicServiceCase directly for public endpoints
apply aggregation/suppression for aggregate-only, restricted or sensitive cases
review public-area code semantics before publication

mappings.rationale: Expected values in an evaluation corpus specify what a test should detect; they are not model outputs, runtime commands or permission to act. The corpus must never be wired directly to production mutations.
required_guards: use corpus only for evaluation
capture real model outputs separately from expected fixtures
keep advisory reasoning side-effect free

mappings.rationale: Work Case is tenant-scoped operational state; Sol-Atlas is a separate civic projection. Equal or similar identifiers do not prove common incident identity and can reveal private work records if copied publicly.
required_guards: keep source repository, schema, tenant and native ID in an internal mapping
never expose tenant_id or internal case IDs in a public projection
require purpose and access checks before looking up an external record

mappings.rationale: Work Case classifications public/internal/confidential/restricted and Sol-Atlas visibility public/redacted_public/restricted/private differ in vocabulary and publication meaning. In particular, Work Case confidential and internal do not automatically imply a public redaction policy.
required_guards: default to the more restrictive classification when policy requires a crosswalk
require a reviewed classification matrix and purpose-specific public projection
do not publish individual cases from an unreviewed mapping

mappings.rationale: Work Case priority is a tenant-policy-defined integer where 1 is highest; Mycelix urgency is a semantic class. Numeric priority is not an urgency or harm level and can vary by tenant policy.
required_guards: preserve numeric priority plus tenant policy version separately
do not turn provider SLA priority into resident urgency
review consequences and equity impact before any presentation-only mapping

mappings.rationale: Work Case state is operational workflow state, and revision is an optimistic-concurrency token. Sol-Atlas event states include resolution claim and independent verification; Work Case resolved/closed does not prove physical restoration.
required_guards: never map resolved or closed to VerifiedResolved without independent target evidence
do not manufacture Sol-Atlas append-only events from a snapshot
do not expose Work Case state or revision in a public case without an explicit reviewed projection
remain blocked until both contracts and the explicit adapter qualify

invariants: The crosswalk is descriptive metadata; no mapping rule is executable.
Unknown, unavailable, stale, invalid, conflicting, missing and zero remain distinct.
Model output, source attestation, consensus, signature and digest do not by themselves establish physical truth or action authority.
Only explicit, reviewed public projections may expose civic records; internal record serialization is not a public API contract.
Work Case V1 and Operations Event V1 schemas are pinned from separate public draft PRs, but remain unqualified; adapters must stay blocked until source-specific exact-head checks pass.
A record's native ID, lifecycle state, priority, visibility class, event time, and digest subject must not be copied across contracts merely because fields look similar.
non_goals: No record merge or fuzzy entity resolution.
No live municipal connectors or service submissions.
No authority, eligibility, legal-compliance, fraud or service-restoration decisions.
No public disclosure of personal data, exact household locations, private ticket IDs or sensitive infrastructure.
